verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents first-party integrations for Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, Hono and 20+ other frameworks, plus server-side auth.api methods for authenticating users. Community reports confirm that usage is consistent across frameworks and that a team moved from Next.js to Hono by changing only the router. The JWT/JWKS plugin is a building block for verification, but the pack never shows route-protection middleware or edge-runtime session checks. missing for 10: documented route-protection middleware (e.g. Next.js middleware helpers), explicit edge-runtime session verification, independent hands-on corroboration of route guarding.
